role: secondary claim gate; never blocks the primary response-filter test
question: Can site-level local process variance be recovered well enough from the frozen sampling schedules to distinguish demographic buffering from decoupling-with-local-instability?

simulation.variance_pattern: half of sites within each species receive baseline process SD and half receive 2x process SD, assigned deterministically from an outcome-blind ordering balanced across forcing groups

estimator.rule: After integrated fitting, compute site residual increment variance after fitted drift and fitted shared-forcing contribution. Correct interval residual squares for collapsed observation variance at both interval endpoints and divide by interval duration.
estimator.aggregation: Pool corrected residual variance per site with nonnegative truncation only at the variance-estimate boundary.
estimator.minimum_information: at least 4 usable adjacent-season residual intervals per site

interpretation: Pass: Paper 2 may test whether weak regional coupling coexists with elevated local process variance.
Fail: remove/demote the decoupling-with-instability claim; do not change the primary lambda or A x H model.
No site trait is selected or changed based on this variance recovery.
boundary: No real count magnitude is opened.
This gate cannot rescue or overturn a failed primary integrated recovery gate.
No alternative residual definition, minimum-interval threshold or variance transformation may be selected after real outcomes are opened.
